## What the existing UI does (do not redesign functionality)

This is an **internal AI research assistant** — a chat app that answers questions against a private document knowledge base and returns cited answers. Four user-facing pages:

- `/` — Landing page. Marketing hero ("Research Agent — Powered by AI"), 4 feature cards (Deep Research, RAG Pipeline, AI Analysis, High Performance), CTAs to Login / View Source.
- `/auth/login` — Email + password login form.
- `/auth/register` — Email + password + name registration form.
- `/chat` — The main app. Left sidebar with past chat sessions (collapsible on mobile). Main pane: streaming chat messages with the assistant, including inline citations under each answer. A composer at the bottom with a search-mode selector (Auto / Search DB / Chat) and a source submenu (Mixed / arXiv / Tavily). Empty state shows a greeting + 4 suggestion prompts.

## What needs to look better (from UI_AUDIT.md)

🔴 HIGH:
- **No semantic design tokens.** Palette is currently just black/white + ad-hoc `bg-red-500/10`, `text-green-400` accents. Need named tokens for: primary surface, elevated surface, border subtle, border strong, text primary, text secondary, text muted, accent, success, warning, danger, focus ring.
- **Zero ARIA attributes.** Need `aria-label`, `aria-expanded`, `role="log"` (chat stream), `role="navigation"` (sidebar), etc.
- **Dark mode hardwired.** Need a light theme + a working light/dark/system toggle.
- **`alert()` after signup** breaks the aesthetic — need an inline success state instead.
- **`window.location.reload()` to start a new chat** — needs a proper "New chat" affordance that clears state without a page reload (you don't write the JS, just describe the interaction).

🟡 MEDIUM:
- **Glassmorphism overuse flattens hierarchy.** Every surface uses the same `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)`. Introduce 2–3 distinct elevation tiers so the eye knows where to look.
- **Mobile responsiveness is shallow** (~15 responsive utility classes app-wide). The chat suggestion grid, sidebar transitions, and composer need real mobile breakpoints.
- **Session loading state is plain text "Loading..."** Need a branded skeleton.
- **Disclaimer text uses `text-white/30` at `text-xs`** — likely below WCAG AA contrast.

## Brand

- **No formal brand yet** — evolve the current **black-and-white glassmorphism** aesthetic, do not replace it.
- **Primary color**: keep monochrome. Use white as the primary surface accent on dark, black as the primary on light.
- **Accent color**: introduce **one** restrained accent (suggest a cool blue around `#3B82F6` or a soft violet around `#8B5CF6`) for primary CTAs, links, and focus rings. Used sparingly.
- **Neutral palette**: define 8 steps from `--bg-0` (page background) through `--bg-1` (elevated card), `--bg-2` (popovers/menus), to `--text-muted`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-primary`.
- **Success / warning / danger**: defined as tokens (`--color-success`, `--color-warning`, `--color-danger`) — not inline Tailwind opacity hacks.
- **Body font**: Inter (already loaded via next/font). Don't change.
- **Heading font**: same as body, weight `600`–`700`. Optional: try Space Grotesk for headings as a variation.
- **Logo**: text-only, "AI Research Agent", in Inter `600`. No glyph yet.
- **Tone**: technical + bold + modern.
- **Reference sites/apps** (for feel — do NOT clone): **Vercel** (bold dark hero, sharp gradients, generous whitespace), **ChatGPT** (familiar chat layout, clean message hierarchy, sidebar history pattern), **Perplexity** (citation-first answer presentation).

### Visual personality (2–3 lines)
Feels like a precise instrument for serious work — not a consumer app. Dark by default but readable in light mode. One restrained gradient (hero only), no rainbow accents, no playful illustrations. Surfaces have a quiet depth — backdrop blur + subtle elevation tiers, not a flat poster.

## Constraints

### Responsive
- **Desktop primary, mobile usable** — design for ≥ 1024px first; degrade gracefully down to 360px.
- Breakpoints: `640px` (tablet), `1024px` (desktop), `1280px` (wide).
- Tap targets minimum **44 × 44 px** on mobile.
- No horizontal scroll on any viewport ≥ 320px.

### Accessibility (HIGH priority — current app has zero ARIA)
- **WCAG 2.1 AA** minimum.
- Every `<img>` has an `alt` attribute (none today).
- Form fields have **visible labels** (not placeholder-only).
- Contrast ratio ≥ **4.5:1** for body text, ≥ 3:1 for large text.
- **Focus states are visible** for keyboard users — design a custom focus ring using the accent token, never `outline: none` without a replacement.
- Interactive elements are real `<button>` / `<a>` (not styled `<div>`s).
- Custom dropdowns (the search-mode selector with a submenu) need `role="menu"` / `role="menuitem"` / `aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` baked in.
- Chat message stream gets `role="log"` + `aria-live="polite"`.
- Sidebar nav gets `role="navigation"` + `aria-label="Past chats"`.

### Theming (HIGH priority — currently dark-only)
- Must ship both **light** and **dark** themes from day one.
- Theme switching is driven by a `data-theme` attribute on `<html>` (`data-theme="light"` / `data-theme="dark"`). All tokens read from CSS variables that switch on that attribute.
- Provide a 3-state theme toggle (light / dark / system) somewhere reachable from the chat page header.
- Default to `system`.

### State coverage (required for every async interaction)
1. **Loading** — skeleton or branded spinner, not plain "Loading...".
2. **Success** — default rendered state.
3. **Empty** — explicit empty-state UI:
   - `/chat` empty state: greeting + 4 suggestion prompts (today: "What is RAG?", "Explain embedding models", "Summarize recent papers", "Best practices for vector DBs").
   - Sidebar empty state: "No past chats yet" + CTA to start one.
4. **Error** — readable error message + a retry path where applicable.

### Hard constraints
- No new heavy dependencies — design only.
- Must respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (current gradient blob animation ignores it).

## Existing design tokens (REUSE — do not invent new colors)

The project already defines these in `web/src/app/globals.css`. Keep the names; extend the system around them rather than replacing.

```css
:root {
  --background: #000000;
  --foreground: #ffffff;
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

@theme {
  --color-glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --color-glass-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  --color-glass-highlight: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
```

Propose the full token set as an extension of these — keep `--background`, `--foreground`, `--color-glass-*` names. Add the missing ones (semantic accents, elevation tiers, text colors, focus ring).

- **One HTML file per page** redesigned (4 files: `landing.html`, `login.html`, `register.html`, `chat.html`). No shared layout file — easier to copy chunks back into React.
- **One shared `styles.css`** with all design tokens at the top (`:root` for light, `[data-theme="dark"]` for dark).

- **Block structure that mirrors React component boundaries** (e.g. `<aside class="chat-sidebar">`, `<section class="chat-message" data-role="assistant">`, `<form class="chat-composer">`) so we can port one piece at a time.

## Iteration

Provide **2–3 visual variations** of the chat page (`/chat`) side-by-side, since it's the dominant surface:

- **Variation 1 — Refined current direction.** Keep glassmorphism but introduce proper elevation tiers + restrained accent. Dark default.
- **Variation 2 — Vercel-inspired.** Flatter surfaces, sharper edges, one bold gradient in the empty-state hero only, more typographic contrast. Dark default.
- **Variation 3 — Light-mode-first.** Show what the system looks like in light theme — paper-white surfaces, dark text, the same accent color. Prove the tokens work both ways.

I will pick one (or mix) and then you refine.
